Inside the app

Everything Finrival does, at a glance

Market
Top gainers and decliners with one-month charts, plus daily trading activity by sector
Compare
Two stocks or coins side by side, with Rival View, Wealth Simulator and an AI Battle Report
Finrival AI
Answers that start from the screen you’re on, powered by Google Gemini
Rival
A practice portfolio that starts with RC 100,000 in fictional credits
Watchlist
Up to 5 assets on Free and 25 on PRO, with one-time price alerts
News
Latest headlines for each asset, with the source and time on every story
Learn
Five short market questions a day, with topic rounds on PRO
